title: Shared definitions
description: Types reused by every record schema. All text is UTF-8 in Unicode Normalization Form C; scripts/check_text.py enforces that, because JSON Schema cannot.

slug.description: Lowercase words joined by hyphens. Stable once published.

version.description: Semantic version of the content track.

stateCode.description: Two-letter USPS code for a state, DC or territory (e.g. NV, AK, HI, PR, GU, AS, MP, VI).

partialDate.description: A year, year and month, or full date (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD), for facts whose source gives only part of a date.

languageTag.description: BCP 47 language tag (RFC 5646), e.g. 'chr' (Cherokee), 'nv' (Navajo), 'haw' (Hawaiian), or 'chr-Cher' for Cherokee written in the syllabary.

confidence.description: How well the cited source supports the value. high: stated directly by a primary official source (the nation itself, a statute, a regulation, the Federal Register, or a federal or state agency list) published or updated within about five years. medium: a reputable secondary source, a primary source older than about five years, or a value that needed names matched between sources. low: a single unofficial source, an undated source, conflicting sources (explained in the note), or a search-result snippet. With no source, the value is left out rather than guessed.

verification.description: How closely the value was checked against its source, separate from how good the source is (confidence). read-in-full: the part of the document that states the value was read. title-only: only a title, link text, heading or table-of-contents line was seen. bulk-import: copied from a row of a list, directory, database or data table without opening the underlying document. inferred: derived rather than stated, for example matched to the nation by name, assigned by a rule (such as a state's Public Law 280 status), or taken from another nation's document. Required on every new or changed fact (scripts/lint_records.py; decision record 0014).

cited.description: Citation carried by every fact in a profile: the source key, how well it supports the value, when the value was true, and where in the source it appears. Schemas that use it add their own properties and set unevaluatedProperties to false.

source.description: Key of a record in content/sources/.

as_of.description: When the value was true or published, as the source states it.

locator.description: Where in the source: page, section, table or row.

document_version.description: The version of a document this fact describes, when its source is one version of a document with a history in content/documents/. Naming the version says the fact describes it on purpose, even after a later version replaces it (decision record 0018).

documentVersion.description: One version of a document that has a history: the id of a record in content/documents/ and the id of one of its versions (schemas/document-history.schema.json).

document.description: Id of a document history record in content/documents/.

version.description: Id of a version listed in that record.

jurisdiction.description: A government or legal order a record concerns.

level.description: territory: Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, the Northern Mariana Islands or American Samoa. multiple: several governments together, such as a tribal-state forum or compact.

state.description: For a state or territory: which one.

tribe.description: For a nation: its tribe profile id, once one exists.

methodIds.description: Ids of dispute resolution method records in content/methods/. The list of methods is open: to name a process that has no record, add one with status 'proposed'.

reviewStatus.description: Where a record stands in consultation with the nation it describes (charter, commitment 4).

filingId.description: Id of a private contributor filing (the signed contributor statement and permissions), kept outside the repository, e.g. filing-2026-0001. Public records carry only this id and the public-safe fields below.

credit.description: How a teller, author or contributor is credited. For a contribution, the form the contributor chose; for a published work, the credit the publisher gives.

nation.description: Tribe profile id (content/tribes/) of the nation the person names as theirs.

role.description: e.g. elder, peacemaker, judge, storyteller, cultural office.

permittedUses.description: What the project may do with a story or contribution. For a published source it follows from the source's rights record; for a contribution it is what the contributor granted.

level.description: background-only: informs the work but is never named, described or quoted. reference-only: may be cited, described or paraphrased with credit, not quoted. quote: short quotations. publish-in-full: the whole text may be reproduced.

scope.description: Where the use is allowed; the same list as permission.schema.json.

accessLevel.description: Who may see a story or contribution. nation-review-first: not published until the nation has reviewed it (charter, commitment 4). embargoed: not published before `until`. restricted: never published, exported, cached offline or served by any API (charter, commitment 5).

culturalAuthority.description: Who, with authority under the nation's or community's own protocols, approved sharing. Separate from copyright: a story can be free to quote under copyright law and still need this.

granted_by.description: Role or office, never a private person's contact details, e.g. 'Tribal Historic Preservation Officer', 'clan leader', 'Council of Elders'.

filing.description: Private filing holding the signed authority form.

tribal_review_required.description: True when the record touches community-held knowledge that needs the nation's approval before publication, whatever its copyright status.

local_contexts_notices.description: Notices this project applies through the Local Contexts Hub.

local_contexts_labels.description: Labels applied by the community itself (e.g. 'TK Attribution'). Copied from the Local Contexts Hub; never applied by this project.

restricted.description: True means never publish, export, cache offline, or serve through any API.
